sourceText:
Rich's Spicy Salmon Spread
By: Rich Fletcher
Published: Saturday, November 20, 2010 - 6:53pm

Ingredients




1 can 418Gm Wild Red Pacific Salmon (Or whatever you have)
2 small/medium red onions
1/2 English cucumber
4 Tablespoons Renee's Mighty Caesar Salad Dressing (If not using this one, Id add a clove or two of 1 red chili pepper
Freshly Cracked Black Pepper
a mixing bowl

Preparation

1 Open the can of salmon , pour contents into the bowl, roughly mix 2 Add 3 to 4 table spoons of Caesar salad dressing to bowl, quickly mix 3 Add Freshly cracked pepper to your liking 4 Finely chop the Onions 5 Finely chop the cucumber 6 Mince the chili ( I left the seeds in, optional) 7 Combine in mixing bowl 8 Give this good mix with a spatula, make sure too break up any large pieces. 9 Cover the bowl, and place in the fridge for 30 minutes to let the flavours mingle

About


I grew up having these little salmon and cucumber sandwichs... which were always nice. Finally decided to try a version more to my liking. Alaska Wild Salmon, with red onion, cucumber, chili pepper, and in place of mayo is my favourite caesar dressing.
Simple, and easy. Good for crackers , toast, sandwichs or anything else you want to spread this on, or dip into it :) .

Comments:
Andie Mitchell

Rich, this is a wonderful recipe for a quick, healthy meal. I love that I could serve this with some crackers as an appetizer for a holiday party too! I love that you threw the caesar salad dressing in the mix!
